name: section-header
issues: "section header" is one Figma component used three times on the page in three shapes (title and description; title, text and a photo; title, four titled text blocks and a photo). Each shape is imported as its own lab component: section-header, section-header-media, section-header-text-list.
Text layers have no meaningful names (eyebrow label, title and description are bare text nodes).
Figma variable values depend on the frame's variable mode (space/7 and space/12 read differently in some frames), so only the default-mode values are imported.
